messages:
Marta: Heads up — noticed a recurring bump in the "attribution_state" count that lines up with hourly snapshot jobs. Dashboard shows +2–3% token delta on a few major tenants. anyone seen this before?

Josh: which dashboard/panel are we talking about? the invoice delta or the live usage chart?

Marta: the per-tenant "billing.delta_tokens" timeseries in /console/usage -> the spike shows up at snapshot hour and resolves within ~10m. invoices downstream sometimes include the extra tokens.

Priya: can you paste the exact query panel uses? might be an aggregation window mismatch.

Marta: panel pulls from materialized view: `billing_hourly_snapshot` with `attribution_state` tag. simple query: `SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) FROM billing_hourly_snapshot WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end GROUP BY tenant_id`

Dan: That view is fed by the ingest-worker L0 -> L1 transform. We recently changed the routing fallback to set attribution_state="unrouted" for 1s late events. Could be double-counting if the same request later gets retried with a real route.

Josh: if retries are creating two events (unrouted + routed) and the snapshot dedupe window is too narrow, that explains the 10m blip. What are the dedupe keys?

Marta: dedupe key is `fingerprint || request_id` but request_id is optional for older clients. fallback sets fingerprint but sometimes proxy replays with new request_id.

metering-bot: ingest-worker-03: INFO processed event id=evt_9f3b route=fallback attribution_state=unrouted fingerprint=fp_abc123

Priya: UX question — should the console show both raw and reconciled metrics? ops wants raw for debugging but finance wants reconciled for invoices. Right now we show reconciled by default (which runs the backfill reconcile job nightly).

Josh: finance must have reconciled in invoices always. If the reconciler lags, customers see short-term overcharges. We need invariants: invoices must use reconciled state only, dashboards can be raw+reconciled.

Dan: quick fix: extend the snapshot dedupe window from 30s -> 15m for `unrouted` -> `routed` pairs, and mark `unrouted` as tentative in materialized view (don't include in invoice exports until reconciled).

Marta: we already tag tentative in the transform for some paths but not for proxy-fallback. I can add a rule: if attribution_state transitions to routed within 15m, mark prior as transient and exclude from `billing_export` query.

Priya: from UX side I'll add a toggle on the usage panel: show "include tentative events" with tooltip: "tentative = events awaiting reconciliation; may be removed in invoice export". keeps ops happy.

Josh: long-term: we should standardize a canonical "finalized_at" field on billing events and make invoice exporter only read events with `finalized_at <= export_time`. That prevents ad-hoc heuristics.

Dan: +1 on finalized_at. also propose emitting a reconciliation-event log when reconcile runs: `reconcile: tenant_id x removed 42 tokens from hour y` so we can tie spikes to reconcilers in the timeline.

Marta: action items: 1) I'll patch transform to mark proxy-fallback events as tentative AND emit `orig_request_id` if present. 2) Dan please change dedupe window to 15m for fallback pairs. 3) Priya add the console toggle and annotate panels. 4) Josh you and billing team agree to only read reconciled events for invoice export (I'll add `finalized_at` flag).

Josh: agreed. I'll open a billing-export PR to gate on `finalized_at` and add a test dataset with early-retry scenarios.

Dan: I'll draft the transform diff and add a quick e2e job that simulates proxy double-send.

Marta: quick snippet for transform change (pseudocode):
```
if event.source == 'proxy' and event.fallback == true:
  event.attribution_state = 'unrouted'
  event.tentative = true
  event.orig_request_id = event.headers.get('x-orig-req')
```

Marta: also adding a dashboard alert: fire if `sum(tentative_tokens)` > 1% total for >2 snapshot windows. helps catch regressions.

Priya: love the alert. I'll wire it into the Console and add an example annotation explaining reconciliation lag.

Josh: FYI we should notify support if any tenant's reconciled tokens drop >1% on invoice generation so CS can pre-empt tickets. I'll add to the invoice-runbook.

metering-bot: reconcile-run: INFO tenant=acct_42 removed=128 tokens hour=2026-11-03T02:00:00Z

Marta: thanks all — I'll push the transform patch to canary later today and ping here with results.

Priya: ping me when canary UI events start coming in, I'll validate panels and toggle UX.

Dan: will do a quick smoke: replay a proxy double-send and confirm only reconciled event ends up in `billing_export`.

Marta: closing loop — canary ran, saw the tentative flag set, dedupe caught pairs, dashboard spike gone for tested tenants. Will follow up with the PRs. :tada:
